description: The defined names of a spreadsheet/1 document (node type core.sheet.names, node_id `names`).

names.description: The defined names, in the application's order.

items.description: One defined name: a name that stands for a range, a constant or a formula.

comment.description: A comment. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

formula.description: What the name stands for, as formula text in the profile's formula grammar WITHOUT a leading `=`: `Sheet1!$A$1:$A$10`, `0.07`, `LAMBDA(x,x*2)`. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

hidden.description: Not listed in the user interface.

name.description: The name, e.g. `TaxRate`. Compared case-insensitively. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

scope_index.description: Only for a damaged scope: a zero-based sheet position that names no sheet of the workbook. Never present together with scope_sheet.

scope_sheet.description: node_id of the core.sheet.sheet node the name is local to. Absent (together with scope_index) for a workbook-wide name.

schema_version.description: Revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile spreadsheet/1.

title: core.sheet.names - defined names
